data.title: Distribute via CI-built artifacts on the GitHub Releases page
data.description: Distribution machinery must match the audience that exists today

data.title: Bridge to macOS through purego with CGO_ENABLED=0
data.description: Bind OS primitives through purego, CGO off; prove each symbol on real hardware first

data.title: Fail loudly when Accessibility is not granted
data.description: Fail with the responsible party named; never report an empty world as success

data.title: Two test tiers; the integration tier fails, never skips
data.description: Pure coverage universal; the real seam tested on real hardware; a skip is a green lie

data.title: Group windows by bundle id, not PID
data.description: Group by product identity (bundle id), never process identity

data.title: Report windows the tool cannot act on instead of hiding them
data.description: Never hide what the tool cannot act on; incomplete enumeration fails the run

data.title: Order display indexes by row, then left to right
data.description: Indexes follow the known ordering; stable identity is UUID or name

data.title: Fail strictly on a mismatched frame, with a numeric tolerance
data.description: Verification is never off; widen numerically and deliberately

data.title: Never activate applications during a bulk apply
data.description: Bulk operations never fight the user for focus

data.title: Retry a mismatched frame three times with a 25 ms pause
data.description: Three attempts before judging a frame; retry, then once after 25 ms

data.title: Each --match opens a rule; sibling flags bind to it
data.description: One quoting layer; the CLI grammar is the saved-profile grammar

data.title: Spell regexes as /pattern/, terminated at the last slash
data.description: One regex spelling everywhere; remaining ambiguity fails loudly

data.title: Use stdlib flag with a hand-rolled subcommand table
data.description: Stdlib parsing, hand-rolled dispatch; no CLI framework

data.title: Use goccy/go-yaml so profile comments survive saves
data.description: Hand comments are user data; every write preserves them and survives interruption

data.title: Resolve the profile directory dotfiles-first
data.description: Config is dotfiles-first: env override, XDG, ~/.config; never a path with a space

data.title: Profiles are authored from flags or the template, not captured
data.description: Automate the repeated task, not the rare one

data.title: The terminal app is the TCC client; no daemon mode
data.description: Shell-launched only; the terminal app owns the grant (split from 0001)

data.title: Demo mode replays a recorded world and simulates placement
data.description: Fabricated output is a documentation prop: env-gated, cmd-wired, doctor-disclosed, never in tests

data.title: Animated demos are VHS tapes rendered through demo mode
data.description: A demo must be regenerable by script from checked-in sources; a human-at-the-desk recording is a screenshot with extra steps

data.title: An omitted region means maximize
data.description: Where is mandatory, how big is defaulted; the common rule is the short one

data.title: One-letter aliases for the rule grammar; destructive flags stay long
data.description: A letter for what you type per rule, the full word for what you cannot undo

data.title: Accept en-GB region spellings, canonicalise them on parse
data.description: Type it either way, store it one way; an alias never reaches disk

data.title: Every region name has a shorthand code; thirds use digits
data.description: Letters for halves and corners, digits for thirds, so no code is a transposition of another

data.title: Every command answers to its initial
data.description: The first letter is the command's short name, so a new command must claim a free one

data.title: Three verbs, and a profile is named by flag
data.description: A command is what you are doing; a profile is which one, and that is a flag

data.title: status elides titles and takes a section
data.description: A table that holds its shape by default; the whole truth on request, and always in JSON

data.title: Embed a jq engine behind --jq rather than shell out
data.description: The filter travels in the binary, so --json stays useful where jq is not installed

data.title: An incomplete enumeration blocks only the runs it could have changed
data.description: A gap in the world stops the run when a rule could have matched into it, not merely because it exists
